predictions.reasoning: Harvey Weinstein's criminal sentencing in a New York retrial is a legal/personal matter with no material link to any publicly-traded asset. The Weinstein Company collapsed and its assets were sold years ago (much acquired by Lantern Capital/Spyglass), so there is no listed equity exposed to this outcome. There is no commodity, index, FX, or ETF whose price would move on a sentencing bracket. The prediction market is essentially a legal betting line with zero information leakage into liquid financial instruments.

evidence_used: Market concerns an individual's criminal sentencing, not a corporate or macro event
The Weinstein Company is defunct; its assets were liquidated and sold to private buyers
No listed equity, ETF, commodity, index, or FX instrument has direct exposure to the sentencing outcome
Primary topic tag 'elections' appears mislabeled; this is a criminal justice matter
uncertainty_notes: If undisclosed civil litigation or insurance exposure existed at a listed insurer, there could be a marginal link, but none is evident

llm_justification.summary: This prediction market tracks the prison sentence in Harvey Weinstein's New York criminal retrial. It is a purely legal/personal outcome with no clean transmission channel to any liquid public-market instrument. The Weinstein Company is defunct and its assets long since sold to private parties, so no listed equity is exposed. There is no tradable proxy; the appropriate call is 'unclear' with a near-zero expected move.
key_assumptions: No publicly-listed company has material financial exposure to the sentencing outcome
Criminal sentencing brackets do not transmit to commodity, index, or FX prices
Any entertainment-sector movement in the window would be coincidental
failure_modes: A hidden litigation/insurance exposure at a listed firm could exist and be missed
Broad media-sentiment effects might exist but are too diffuse and small to be tradable
The market may already reflect fully public trial information, offering no leakage even if a proxy existed
